  • Own core parts of our Linux production infrastructure, including performance, scaling, failover, and replication
  • Build and extend platform features in our Symfony-based control plane
  • Be the person who handles production issues when they escalate past support
  • Work directly with the founders on architecture and priorities, with no product manager layer in between

  • Deep experience with PHP/Symfony
  • Hands-on background in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure-heavy backend roles

  • Self-directed, takes ownership in a small team
  • Writes clearly: design docs, incident postmortems, async updates that don't need a follow-up call
  • Familiarity with Go and Odoo is a plus

Why join us

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the option to work locally from Brussels
  • High ownership and direct impact on a platform used by thousands of businesses
  • A small, fast-moving team with very little bureaucracy
